mapper.sql: MENU_NUMB , SUBX_NUMB , MENU_NAME , MENU_URLX , SORT_ORDR , USEE_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{commYsno}, USEE_YSNO, #{useeYsnoCode}) AS USEE_YSNO_NAME , REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , REGI_DATE , UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , UPDT_DATE
mapper.select: /*getMenuList*/ SELECT M.MENU_NUMB , M.SUBX_NUMB , M.MENU_NAME , M.MENU_URLX , M.SORT_ORDR , M.USEE_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{commYsno}, M.USEE_YSNO, #{useeYsnoCode}) AS USEE_YSNO_NAME , M.REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(M.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , M.REGI_DATE , M.UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(M.UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , M.UPDT_DATE FROM TM_ADMENU M JOIN TB_AUTHMN A ON A.MENU_NUMB = M.MENU_NUMB AND A.SUBX_NUMB = M.SUBX_NUMB AND A.AUTH_CODE = #{authCode} AND A.READ_YSNO = #{yes} JOIN TM_AUTHXM G ON G.AUTH_CODE = A.AUTH_CODE AND NVL(G.USEE_YSNO, #{yes}) = #{yes} LEFT JOIN TM_ADMENU P ON P.MENU_NUMB = M.MENU_NUMB AND P.SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb} WHERE NVL(M.USEE_YSNO, #{yes}) = #{yes} ORDER BY NVL(P.SORT_ORDR, M.SORT_ORDR) , TO_NUMBER(M.MENU_NUMB) , CASE WHEN M.SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , NVL(M.SORT_ORDR, 9999) , TO_NUMBER(M.SUBX_NUMB)

/*getMenuMngList*/ SELECT FROM TM_ADMENU M WHERE M.SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb} ORDER BY NVL(( SELECT P.SORT_ORDR FROM TM_ADMENU P WHERE P.MENU_NUMB = M.MENU_NUMB AND P.SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb} ), M.SORT_ORDR) , TO_NUMBER(M.MENU_NUMB) , CASE WHEN M.SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , NVL(M.SORT_ORDR, 9999) , TO_NUMBER(M.SUBX_NUMB)
